WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
             ELSE 0 END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
date_ranges AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date)::DATE as earliest, MAX(txn_date)::DATE as latest
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, earliest, latest,
    (date_trunc('day', earliest::DATE) + (seq * INTERVAL '1 day'))::DATE as txn_date
  FROM date_ranges,
    UNNEST(generate_series(0, (latest - earliest)::INTEGER)) AS seq(seq)
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.txn_date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.customer_id ORDER BY ad.txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dn.txn_date
),
clamped AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, GREATEST(running_balance, 0) as daily_balance
  FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as month,
    MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
  FROM clamped
  GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER
)
SELECT year, month, SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY year, month
ORDER BY year, month
